snippet.title: Guilty As Charged! - Demo Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Set in a dystopian world where even small crimes are punished in permanence, Guilty As Charged! sees 20-year-old Alan Pierce fight for victory in a televised gameshow between 18 criminals where the winner not only keeps their life, but gains a huge cash prize – as well as their freedom.

Keep up with progress on Guilty As Charged! over at our Discord:
https://discord.gg/MTDDvhqZ7S

© Judgement Studios 2025
